pages.text: The $(d)Biome Radar$() is a multiblock structure that helps you find biomes in the world.$(br2)Build the structure shown on the next page.

pages.name: Biome Radar
pages.text: Required blocks:$(br2)$(li)1 Biome Radar$(br)$(li)10 Iron Bars

Insert a $(d)Biome Crystal$() into the radar. There is one for each biome in the game, and they can be found in almost any chest with loot.$(br2)If the biome exists in the world, the flames above the Iron Bars will blow in its direction.

Use a $(l:irregular_implements:filter/location_filter)Location Filter$(/l) on the radar to save the biome's location.$(br2)Craft that filter with a $(l:irregular_implements:items/golden_compass)Golden Compass$(/l) to make your way there!
